1.

No distance between Christ And His redeemed bride. Himself on the cross He removed All that separated us from God.

2.

He Himself has sanctified Himself for us, Sanctification for us He won, Promised to be in the midst of us, When we gather unto His name.

3.

He has given us of His Spirit, Brought us into His liberty. The bride can say from the heart: “I am His, and He is mine.”

4.

Ever may He be our confidant, He who is our heart’s Friend, That we may apprehend His will And with joy do it.
